Small update of the help. Nothing changes in how Bookbench works.

## Changed

- *Help > Costs and privacy* now lists every connection Bookbench makes, including the update check (no telemetry).
- The README has short sections on privacy and on how the Windows setup is built.

## Install

- **Linux:** *Help > Check for updates* in an installed copy, or `install.sh` from this repository.
- **Windows:** `Bookbench_Setup_2.0.2.exe` (not signed yet: SmartScreen > *More info* > *Run anyway*).
